meta.title: Ondra Hormone Layer
meta.description: An optional slow-variable reading. High stress hormone means she is braced and speaks shorter; high reward hormone means she is willing to say a little more; high bonding hormone means she wants to stay close. These only explain which layer is pushing her right now — they never change her actual mood, which still has exactly one source of truth. Off by default; turn it on when you want the finer view.
